description: This file contains utility methods for handling maps and number parsing, such as finding the closest key in a sorted map, retrieving or creating a value in a map, and parsing integers with exception handling.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for map operations and number parsing.

methods.name: findClosest
methods.description: Finds the key in the map which is closest to the specified value.

methods.name: getOrCreate
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the map by key, or creates and inserts a new one if the key is not present.

methods.name: parseIntWithReason
methods.description: Parses a string into an integer, throwing an exception with a custom reason if parsing fails.
